summary: Re-ran the two host-suite failures and the cairn tests live (human idle): all pass in isolation, so both failures only happen after earlier tests in the full suite. The new cairn pickup/set test and the critter cairn test pass.

failures.what: In the full suite, after the cairn tests, a wave is not answered: 'nobody answered the wave (Wibbles is interact)'
failures.steps: Run the full suite; the Jump-in wave test comes after the Cairn/Flower tests. Wibbles is still in an :interact goal (chat or cheering) and no creature has :answer or :follow.
failures.expected: A creature answers an E wave, or the previous test leaves no creature stuck in :interact.
failures.actual: Fails in the suite, passes alone (6.1 s). State outlives an earlier test (w.interactions or the cairn cheer from #181).

failures.what: Creatures stand inside each other: Gloop and Wibbles 0.74 m apart (needs >= 0.95 of summed body radii)
failures.steps: Run the full suite; the Separation test runs after the cairn/cheer tests. Cheering critters crowd round the cairn.
failures.expected: Separation pushes them apart within 5 frames.
failures.actual: 0.74 m apart in the suite; passes alone (0.1 s). Probably a cairn cheer or interaction that pulls creatures together and ignores Separation.
